description: Sumideros is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. Ubicación geográfica y denominación de los sumideros de la red pluvial de la Ciudad. Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AR. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
